messages:
matt: FYI I just spent 20 minutes debugging why a feature flag went true. It was a literal tab in the YAML. Tabs: the final boss of inference. :sweat_smile:
ana: Tabs vs spaces, but make it tragic. Also proposing we adopt calendar semver: `2026.03.coffee` as the official format. :coffee:
miri: Don’t tempt the release managers. next they’ll want `v2026.03.23-beta+latte` and we'll have to support caffeine metadata. :joy:
eli: CI started failing with this gem earlier: `error: expected ';' but found 'developer burnout'` — the compiler is now sending HR tickets. :rofl:
ci-bot: build #4821 failed on lint: `yaml: line 14: found tab character that violates indentation`. Suggested fix: convert tabs to 2 spaces. See docs: https://example.internal/devdocs/yaml-formatting
matt: Here’s the offending block i pasted from the file (note the sneaky tab before `enabled:`):
```yaml
feature_flags:
	experimentalWidget:
	enabled: true

# works if you replace the tab with two spaces
```
ana: My brain: "That tab is a feature, not a bug." My manager: "That tab is a liability."
miri: Also, question: is semver now allowed to contain emoji in build metadata? Asking for a friend who wants `1.4.2+🚀`.
eli: we used to have a PR template that rejected emoji in tags, but then someone pushed `v0.0.0-unstable☕` and the universe corrected itself.
matt: Proposal: enforce `preference: spaces` in .editorconfig and a linter rule that reacts with :cop: if violated.
nana: Or we just deploy a punybot that replaces tabs with two spaces and leaves a sticky note: "I took the liberty."
ci-bot: autopatcher applied to 3 files. re-run your job to confirm.
miri: Lol thanks ci-bot. I owe you a coffee if you ever become sentient. :coffee::robot_face:
eli: Meeting minutes: 1) Tabs are banned, 2) emoji semver remains a personal hobby, 3) everyone gets a sticker that says "I survived YAML"
matt: Sticker would definitely improve morale. Closing thread with a solemn vow: never mix tabs and YAML after 10am. :v:
